title: KCNA: Kim Oversees Launch of Intermediate-Range Missile Claimed to Use AI and Evasive Flight
detail: State media reported Kim Jong Un, with his daughter, oversaw the launch, said to be training for troops operating a 'hypersonic strategic weapon system'. Kim Yo Jong claimed a 'wavelike trajectory' and unspecified AI features that defeat missile-defense tracking. Claims are unverified by independent analysts. Kim called for bolstering the 'fatality' of offensive weapons.

media.caption: Kim oversees missile launch claimed to use AI
